title: Pringles adopts AI digital twin to perfect chip dough #pringles #digitaltwin #foodmanufacturing
description: Pringles implemented an advanced AI-driven digital twin to perfect their chip-making process. This technology addresses the complex challenge of ensuring each Pringle chip is uniform despite natural variations in potatoes and dough variables. The system analyzes over 200 factors, including flour particle size, dough humidity, and potato origin, replacing the traditional role of a dough maker who manually adjusted the production line. After four years and a $5 million investment in collaboration with Simon’s, this innovation enhances consistency and quality control in food manufacturing. This approach demonstrates the growing impact of AI and digital twins in optimizing industrial food production, reducing waste, and improving product standardization on a large scale. #Pringles #AIDigitalTwin #FoodManufacturing #SimonDigitalTwin #ChipProduction #FoodTech #ManufacturingInnovation #AIinFoodIndustry #QualityControl #PotatoChips #IndustrialAutomation #FoodQuality #ProcessOptimization #SmartManufacturing #TechInFood
